scope: Automation output against independent oracles at a fractional tempo, through live replacement, under concurrent replacement and across Save/reopen
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none

thread-sanitizer.note: Local -fsanitize=thread build of automation-qualification-tests, three runs, no reports

verified_behaviors: Bar boundaries from 128-bit integer arithmetic (86401, 172801, 259201 at 133.333 BPM) agree with TempoGrid
Gain and pan lanes with a render-owned next-bar scene launch and next-bar stop match the independent interpolation oracle on all 269,201 stereo frames within 1e-6
A plan replacement swaps the level lane mid-segment at an exact frame; output identical at blocks 1/64/127/257/1000/4096; no allocation intercepted while processing
1023 concurrent automation replacements: every sample belongs to one plan and values never step back

Desktop: level/pan lanes at 137 BPM survive Save and reopening in a fresh session with the same track IDs, mute state and points; float exports are sample-identical and sampled frames match the stated rounding and interpolation exactly
limits: Song-time level and pan lanes only; offline engine and offscreen desktop export; no physical audio.
